page_title: REN 2-2 LIL | Rennes v Lille 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Tiago Santos (Lille) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.

90+7' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
90+6' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+6' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90+5' A spell of possession for Rennes in an attempt to control the game.
90+5' Rennes restart play with a quick free kick.
90+5' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. One of the players from Lille won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Rennes.
90+4' Fabian Rieder (Rennes) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands.
90+3' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Benjamin Andre (Lille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Rennes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Lucas Chevalier. He makes it 2:2.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is coming onto the pitch as Remy Cabella cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Jerome Brisard shows the yellow card to Angel Gomes (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
86' Remy Cabella (Lille) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
86' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Jonathan David (Lille) for a tough tackle.
85' Tiago Santos (Lille) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathis Lambourde (Rennes) coming on for Nemanja Matic.
80' Here is a change. Ivan Cavaleiro is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
80' A substitution has been made. Yusuf Yazici is replaced by Tiago Santos (Lille).

78' A neat pass finds Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier denies him with a good save.
78' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' 1 - 2 Goal! Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 1:2.
71' Lille are ruled offside.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Fabian Rieder (Rennes) is replacing Baptiste Santamaria.
64' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Amine Gouiri will be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
64' Here comes a substitution. Enzo Le Fee is given a rest as he is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
63' Leny Yoro (Lille) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda makes a magnificent save!
62' 0 - 2 Goal! Bafode Diakite (Lille) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:2.
61' Lille take a short corner kick.

61' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
55' The game has come to an end for Desire Doue. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
51' A yellow card for a tackle by Bafode Diakite (Lille). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

48' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

33' 0 - 1 It's the free kick. Leny Yoro (Lille) gets on the end of a cross from Remy Cabella and shows great technique to fire the ball into the back of the net. His effort from the edge of the box flies inside the left post and changes the score to 0:1.
32' Today's referee Jerome Brisard rightly decides to book Nemanja Matic (Rennes) for his harsh tackle.
30' The foul by Yusuf Yazici (Lille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jerome Brisard.
27' Remy Cabella almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Yusuf Yazici (Lille) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Samuel Umtiti (Lille) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
18' Some patient build-up play from Lille as they look to unlock the defence.
15' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
13' Ismaily (Lille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Leny Yoro (Lille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
9' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
9' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Remy Cabella (Lille) causes Steve Mandanda little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
4' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
3' Benjamin Andre (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Rennes will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard was nominated as the referee for this game.
